classification.difficultyReason: Identify the rectangle's diagonal as a hypotenuse, apply Pythagoras and simplify the resulting square root.

content.prompt: Find the length of the diagonal $DB$ of the rectangle. Express your answer in simplest form.

spec.description: Rectangle with width 6, height 3 and diagonal DB. Retain B and D for the named diagonal; omit redundant A and C.
spec.mathematics: DB is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with perpendicular sides 6 and 3.
